create.name: Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso
create.bio:
Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso is a scholar of ancient Mediterranean religion and a teacher of the Sacred Feminine, best known for her research on divine and virgin birth traditions and on Mother Mary and Mary Magdalene. She holds a PhD in Humanities and an MA in Philosophy and Religion from the California Institute of Integral Studies, trained in intuitive development at the Foundation for Spiritual Development, and taught religion and women's spirituality at several Bay Area universities before helping to set up an MA in Myth, Cosmology and the Sacred at Canterbury Christ Church University in England.

In 2012 she founded Seven Sisters Mystery School, through which she teaches the oracle and priestess traditions of the ancient world, the lineage of the Marys, the Pleiades and the faery realms. Her work combines historical scholarship with guided meditation, ceremony and oracular transmission, offered through on-demand courses, a monthly online membership called the Inner Sanctum Temple, and a six-month Mary and Magdalene priestess training. Her books include The Secret Life of Mother Mary, The Mystery Tradition of Miraculous Conception, and two academic studies, The Cult of Divine Birth in Ancient Greece and Virgin Mother Goddesses of Antiquity.

books.title: The Secret Life of Mother Mary: Divine Feminine Power for Personal Healing and Planetary Awakening
books.author: Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso
books.description: A portrait of Mother Mary as a priestess, community leader and spiritual practitioner rather than a passive figure, drawing on early texts and the author's research into the divine birth tradition. It includes guided practices for building a personal relationship with Mary.

books.title: The Mystery Tradition of Miraculous Conception: Mary and the Lineage of Virgin Births
books.author: Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso
books.description: Traces a lineage of holy women in the ancient Mediterranean and Near East who were said to conceive through spiritual means, culminating in Mary and Jesus. It combines historical sources with reflection on what this tradition means for spiritual practice today.

books.title: The Cult of Divine Birth in Ancient Greece
books.author: Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso
books.description: An academic study of evidence that priestesses in ancient Greece were believed to conceive divine children through union with the gods. It looks at figures and sanctuaries from Greek myth and cult practice.

books.title: Virgin Mother Goddesses of Antiquity
books.author: Marguerite Mary Rigoglioso
books.description: A scholarly study of goddesses in the ancient world who were understood to give birth without a male partner, including Gaia, Athena, Artemis and Hera. It follows on from the author's earlier work on the divine birth tradition.

courses.title: Inner Sanctum Temple
courses.description: A monthly online membership with three live calls each month: an oracle and teaching class, a sacred circle with the Marys, and a question-and-answer session. Members also get the replay library and access to most of Marguerite's on-demand courses.
courses.price: $47 USD a month or $564 USD a year

courses.title: Priestess of the Dove Oracle Training ~ Level 1
courses.description: A six-session self-paced course on developing your inner oracle as a channel for Divine Feminine wisdom. It covers sovereignty, energetic boundaries and practical oracle skills, and is open to everyone.

courses.title: Reclaiming Guinevere, Arthur, the Fae & the Round Table
courses.description: An on-demand course on the Arthurian legends as a mystery teaching, exploring Guinevere's origins, Arthur's divine birth, Merlin and the faery lineages of Avalon. It looks at what these stories offer for rebalancing the feminine and masculine today.

courses.title: Divine Birth Mysteries Audio Series
courses.description: A series of recorded talks on the ancient tradition of divine birth, drawn from Marguerite's research into priestesses of ancient Greece. The audios are delivered for listening at your own pace.

courses.title: Reclaiming Our Starry Origins: Cosmic Womb Power to Guide Your Sacred Path
courses.description: A five-session online course, open to all genders, on ancient ideas of the universe as a cosmic mother, the Pleiades and the oracle at Delphi. It weaves Greek scholarship with modern cosmology and spiritual practice.

courses.title: Women's Spirit Power in the Ancient World
courses.description: A three-part on-demand course on the lives of priestesses in ancient Greece, women's sacred use of plants in antiquity, and the North African Amazons. It pairs scholarly background with reflection on women's spiritual leadership today.

courses.title: Cultivating Yourself as a Priestess
courses.description: An online webinar course for women who feel called to a priestess role outside traditional religion. It looks at identifying your gifts and ministry, deepening your practice and making a living from sacred work.

courses.title: Developing Shamanic Power as a Man
courses.description: A five-session course for men with a spiritual calling outside traditional religion, each session lasting 90 minutes. It explores the role of the male spiritual leader and daily sacred practice.

courses.title: Protection for Spirit Workers
courses.description: A course for healers, priestesses and others doing spiritual work who feel exposed or unsure as their work becomes more visible. It teaches practices for energetic protection, boundaries and community support.

courses.title: Creating Your Sacred Sanctuary Within
courses.description: A short three-part guided journey, each part about twelve minutes, on clearing heavy energy, deepening daily connection with the Divine and anchoring a sense of purpose. It comes with a bonus guided audio.

free_resources.title: Become Radiant with Sacred Love ~ Guided Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation with Mother Mary as guide, exploring self-love, romantic, platonic and divine love. Sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: What Does It Mean to Walk the Priestess Path of the Marys Today?
free_resources.description: A free recorded class on the many ways the lineage of Mother Mary and Mary Magdalene can shape a personal spiritual path today. The replay is on the page.
